name: 32060 · Live Oak, FL
findings: ZIP 32060 (Live Oak) has 45 nonprofit organizations. 16 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is volunteering, listed by 11 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (13% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 32060 (Live Oak) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 32060 (Live Oak) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 66% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 15 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 7 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
